title: I turned Claude Code into a 5-person team in 30 sec
description:
Comment GSTACK and I'll DM you the link.

Garry Tan, president of Y Combinator, open-sourced his Claude Code setup. 23 tools that turn it into a full team — CEO, designer, engineer, reviewer, QA. 66K stars on GitHub, MIT license, free.

Amazon already shipped Seller Canvas on Bedrock and Claude inside the seller dashboard. What cost a 5-person team a year ago is now free or built in.

#ClaudeCode #YCombinator #AITools #BuildInPublic #Ecommerce
